mechanism_inventory: missing invariant enforcement: packedInfo not verified to contain fees — attacker supplies arbitrary packedInfo that hashes to match a valid signature, while fees.feeAmount is independently set
access-control mismatch: collectFees is onlyUtb but redeemFees is onlyOwner; if signer is zero (uninitialized), ecrecover returns zero and recovered==signer passes trivially
value exceeds logical bound: native fee (msg.value) accepted via receive() but collectFees never validates msg.value against any declared amount
external-call failure / DoS: redeemFees native branch uses transfer() with fixed 2300 gas which can permanently lock native fees if owner is a contract

hook caller or hook-timing mismatch: packedInfo is caller-supplied; the signature authenticates keccak256(packedInfo) but nothing verifies that packedInfo encodes the same fees struct passed — fees and packedInfo are decoupled
precision / packing / normalization edge: splitSignature reads v non-canonically; for v 0/1 ecrecover returns address(0); if signer uninitialized this passes
unauthorized state deletion / fee bypass: no nonce or used-signature bitmap — a valid signature can be replayed across multiple collectFees calls

selected_mechanisms.root_cause: fees and packedInfo are decoupled: the signature authenticates keccak256(packedInfo) but the contract independently reads fees.feeToken and fees.feeAmount from calldata without verifying they are encoded in packedInfo. A valid signer-approved signature for a packedInfo blob encoding zero fees can be presented while passing fees={feeToken:address(0), feeAmount:0}, collecting zero fees.
selected_mechanisms.attacker_model: needs UTB role (onlyUtb guard) — the UTB contract itself or any actor who can trigger UTB's fee-collection flow
selected_mechanisms.exploit_path: 1. Obtain a valid signature over keccak256(packedInfo_with_zero_fees). 2. Call via UTB with fees.feeAmount=0, feeToken=address(0), and the valid packedInfo+signature. 3. collectFees passes signature check, feeToken==0 skips ERC20 branch, msg.value zero — no fees collected.
selected_mechanisms.who_loses: Protocol / fee collector — intended fees never collected.
selected_mechanisms.who_gains: User initiating the swap avoids fees.
selected_mechanisms.why_carried: Core signed-data/used-data decoupling: signature does not bind the fees struct the contract enforces — classic fee-bypass class.

selected_mechanisms.root_cause: Uninitialized signer allows trivial signature forgery: signer defaults to address(0); ecrecover returns address(0) for malformed signatures; recovered==signer passes unconditionally if setSigner never called.
selected_mechanisms.attacker_model: onlyUtb still required but signature check bypassed entirely when signer uninitialized.
selected_mechanisms.exploit_path: 1. Interact before owner calls setSigner. 2. Submit collectFees with a signature causing ecrecover to return address(0). 3. recovered==signer==address(0) passes.
selected_mechanisms.who_gains: Attacker triggers fee collection with arbitrary signature.
selected_mechanisms.why_carried: Authorization-path mechanism (signer uninitialized) distinct from the decoupling bug; different lifecycle state (initialization).

selected_mechanisms.root_cause: Signature replay: no nonce, no used-signature bitmap, no expiry. A valid signature over a given packedInfo can be replayed indefinitely.
selected_mechanisms.attacker_model: needs UTB role but replay is permissionless once a valid sig is known.
selected_mechanisms.exploit_path: 1. Observe a valid (fees, packedInfo, signature) tuple. 2. Re-submit via UTB with the same signature. 3. collectFees accepts again.
selected_mechanisms.who_loses: Users over-charged if fees collected multiple times; protocol accounting corrupted.
selected_mechanisms.who_gains: Fee collector accumulates excess; or attacker.
selected_mechanisms.why_carried: Distinct replay/missing-nonce mechanism affecting uniqueness invariant.

selected_mechanisms.root_cause: redeemFees native branch uses payable(owner).transfer(amount) (2300 gas). If owner is a contract/multisig, the transfer reverts, permanently locking native ETH fees.
selected_mechanisms.attacker_model: admin-only precondition (owner is a contract) — not permissionless.
selected_mechanisms.exploit_path: 1. Owner is a multisig. 2. redeemFees(address(0), amount). 3. transfer provides 2300 gas; multisig fallback needs more — revert. 4. Native ETH permanently locked.
selected_mechanisms.why_carried: Permanent fund lock (DoS) distinct function (redeemFees) and state (native ETH). Clears Medium floor though requires owner-is-contract.

unresolved_mechanisms.mechanism: Whether fees.feeToken/feeAmount are required to be encoded in packedInfo by the off-chain signer
unresolved_mechanisms.source_evidence: fees and packedInfo are separate calldata arguments with no on-chain binding check.
unresolved_mechanisms.unresolved_question: Does the off-chain signing service guarantee packedInfo encodes the exact fees struct passed? If yes, decoupling only exploitable via compromised/colluding UTB.

rejected_mechanisms.mechanism: ERC20 transferFrom in collectFees draining utb allowance beyond intended amount
rejected_mechanisms.rejecting_source_fact: collectFees is gated by onlyUtb — only the UTB contract can call it; UTB controls the feeAmount.
rejected_mechanisms.why_unexploitable: Without ability to call collectFees directly, an attacker cannot inflate feeAmount.

impact_direction.attacker_receives: Fee bypass (avoid paying protocol fees); replay may accumulate excess fees.
impact_direction.attacker_preserves: Value that should be paid as fees is retained.
impact_direction.victim_loses: Protocol loses intended fee revenue; if owner is a contract, native ETH permanently locked.
impact_direction.invariant_violated: Fee authentication (sig must bind exact fee params), uniqueness (sig usable once), withdrawal safety (owner can recover fees).
impact_direction.not_self_funded_or_dust_or_admin_or_timi: Fee bypass/replay affect all users + protocol revenue — not self-funded/dust; native lock admin-conditional but permanent.
